featured_reviews.name: Hozefa Sadriwala
featured_reviews.review_text:
Are you found of Paani puri? or are you found of Chai? Have you ever imagined, what if these dishes are served to you in the form of ice cream? (Mainey bhi nai socha tha ) Even i didn't think of the same. The ice cream shop 'Apsara' opened now at Lalbaug, deserves a round of applause and the Telead, which i just demonstrated to you'll, for starting such an amazing out of box concept.

Breaking the streoptype of normal boring ice creams, Apsara offers a wide range of flavours which gives you a divine feel. The ambience here from outside is not less than a disco and it's aesthetically soothing. Some of the must try flavours are:
1. Bluberry Cheesecake
2. Guvava glory
3. Trippy Targola
4. Romantic Rose
5. Pani puri patakha
6. Slurpy Sugarcane
7. Crunchy chikki
8. Tamrind Twist
9. Watermelon wonder

With such concept, Apsara makes sure that these flavours are available at a pocket friendly rate starting from a small scoop at Rs.60, medium at Rs.90 and large at Rs.110. They have faloodas available at Rs. 160.

They have recently started a membership programe, where you get 1 point each for every one rupee you spend. The redeem points starts from 99 points = 99 rupees bill  which offers a free scoop on your next visit if you redeem it. There's an exhaustive list with amazing redeeming options. This is one of the best marketing strategy which benefits the customer as well as the outlet.

featured_reviews.name: Shumaila Khan
featured_reviews.review_text:
We paid ₹735 for this bowl of just 6 pieces, and it was honestly one of the most disappointing dessert experiences we’ve had.

The concept looks attractive, and the ice creams are shaped like fruits, but that’s pretty much where the excitement ends. The outer shell was made of white chocolate that didn’t taste premium or particularly good, and none of the pieces had any real fruity flavour. Whether it was the banana, raspberry, orange, or any other shape, they all tasted almost the same.

What was even more disappointing was the filling. Instead of rich fruit-based ice cream or sorbet, it was mostly plain vanilla-flavoured cream with very little to no fruit flavour inside. The appearance creates an expectation of distinct fruit flavours, but the taste simply doesn’t deliver.

For ₹735, you can get far better desserts, artisanal ice creams, or premium gelato elsewhere. The quality, flavour, and overall experience do not justify the price being charged.

If you’re considering visiting because of the unique look or social media appeal, I’d recommend saving your money and trying something else. This is a place you can comfortably skip, especially given the price-to-quality ratio. The presentation is interesting, but the taste and value are severely lacking.

featured_reviews.name: Atul Deshmukh
featured_reviews.review_text:
Ice Cream Works Gold immediately impresses with its very good seating and inviting ambiance. It's a comfortable spot that makes for a pleasant break during a shopping trip. They offer a really good variety of options, both in terms of diverse flavors and the different kinds of servings (including excellent choices for kids!).

The Flavor Breakdown
The selection here is truly impressive, appealing to many different palates:

Toasted, Roasted, Burnt Caramel: This flavor was the absolute standout, earning a rare 5 out of 5. Even for someone who isn't a fan of caramel, the texture was perfect and the flavor was deeply satisfying—a must-try!

Madagascar Chocolate: A solid, high-quality chocolate option that scored a commendable 4 out of 5.

70% Dark Chocolate Ganache: This is for the serious dark chocolate enthusiast. It delivers a very strong flavor that initially hits hard, though it had a noticeable aftertaste, bringing the rating to a 3 out of 5 for me personally.

Amanera Black Cherries from Modena: This had a very distinct flavour that ultimately rated a 3 out of 5. It's certainly unique, but perhaps not universally appealing.

Popsicles
The popsicle options also delivered some fantastic results:

Passion Fruit Mango Popsicle: Another perfect 5 out of 5 flavor! The combination was vibrant, with excellent, true fruit flavors.

Frozen Hot Chocolate Popsicle: This was a decent option but didn't quite reach the heights of the others, coming in at a 3 out of 5.

Overall Verdict
Ice Cream Works offers a fantastic ice cream experience with both a delightful setting and a creative, high-quality menu. While the deep, bold flavors—especially the Toasted, Roasted, Burnt Caramel and the Passion Fruit Mango Popsicle—are worth the visit alone. It's a highly recommended stop for a diverse and indulgent dessert!

featured_reviews.name: Nelwin D'cruz
featured_reviews.review_text:
Elementaria Bakery Cafe 🍰🍷

This outlet is located right opposite of Pheonix high street, lower Parel which takes about 10 minute to get there and is easy to locate.

The ambiance of the place is very pleasing to the eyes and I totally loved it. I would say it's a perfect place for a date 😉

The staff of the place was dressed smarty in their uniform, were polite and are happy to help if you need them. The service is quick too.

The menu consist of wide variety of salads, sandwiches, waffles, slushies, coolers, puff, croissant and a hell lot of cakes 😍😍😍

What I tried?

Black Rose box (Non veg)

The plate consist of Black rice, mix lettuces, pepper, beans, sweet potato, pomegranate, beetroot and a peri peri chicken on top looked very delicious and the portion would suffice for three or four person. Would recommend if you're more into salad.

Nutty apple

A simple delightful drink that's good anytime.

Chicken Ceaser Salad (Bread sandwich) 🥙

This sandwich activated my taste buds, its a perfect combination of chicken, lettuce, herbs and grilled bread. 😍

Tokyo mojito 😍

It's fizzy, lightly sweetened, minty lime and was refreshing.

Oreo Waffle 🍫

A classic delicious waffle with a chocolatey twist. This Oreo waffle for sure will make you come here for more.

AK 47 🍸
A Crunchy chocolate shake with creme and chocolate balls on it looked visually good and tasted delicious.

Kiwi Strawberry lemonade
😍
This is the best cooler I have tried till now a perfect blend of kiwi and strawberry with lemonade. Refreshing and perfect for summer!

Overall it was a great experience! Would definitely love to try more of the menu.

Food: 4.5/5

Service: 4.5/5

Ambiance: 4.5/5

featured_reviews.name: Tristan netto
featured_reviews.review_text: Bite sized meal and fresh stock, this place is filled with some great variety in sandwiches, puffs, pastries etc. Service may take a little longer depending on the crowd. Must have is their pesto sandwich! That is delicious

featured_reviews.name: Kalpesh Bhole
featured_reviews.review_text: Awesome place to visit. Ambience is good. The desserts are the best I have tasted yet. The tub cakes are worth a try. Prices are also worth. Quick bites are also good. Must try the Chicken Lasagne. So much variety of desserts, cakes, coffee, ice cream and what not. The staff is good and so is the service. The croissants are also a must try. And the cutting desserts ahhh just loved them. You must surely visit this place. Good for groups. Those who love chocolate and bakery products then this place belongs to your bucket list.❤️

featured_reviews.name: Savio Dcunha
featured_reviews.review_text:
Elementaria Cafe and Dessert Bar is located  exactly opposite the Phoenix Tower and is small yet conveniently comfortable bakery and dessert bar. Totally drool worthy sight to see Pastries, cupcakes, cookies, croissant on the display. For all you chocolate lovers who are looking for a quick fix whilst in Lower Parel head to Elementaria which is bang opposite Lower Parel.

Value for money, variety, cafe with privacy, friendly staff are some of this Cafe & Dessert Bar's highlight. Special mention to the staff of this place who are super co-operative.

What you should try here is the the season special Cheesecake Popsicle, 48 layer Chocolate Cake, Super Thick Shakes, Croissant and a variety of Cupcakes (recommend to check with the staff).

24 layer pastry-(Recommended) it’s an extremely delicious pastry with super soft layers of chocolaty cake and accompanied with icecream and chocolate sauce.

Minty Popsicle Cheesecake - The Christmas special range of desserts..!! The warmth of the cheesecake and the freshness of Mint topped with edible color pops.!!.

Caramel Sea Salt Milkshake, AK 47 Milkshake, Eli Jumbo (A super loaded dessert with ICe Cream, Chocolate Cake, Fresh Cream, Chocolate poppers, Wafer Sticks, Strawberry Jelly - Caution this is death by sweetness and for a serving for 2 people)

Definitely a place in my bookmark and to visit again list..!!
